# Json

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Formats` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

public static class Json

The one `JsonSerializerOptions` every manifest is read and written with. Serializing with default options silently breaks round-trips, so new manifest code reuses this rather than constructing its own.
